items.title: Introducing device posture assessment for AWS Client VPN
items.summary: AWS Client VPN now offers device posture assessment: make device health a condition of tunnel access. Register a device trust provider (CrowdStrike, Jamf, or JumpCloud), write a Cedar policy, and Client VPN evaluates every connection at connect time and throughout the session. Use shadow mode and connection logs to test a policy before you enforce it.
items.creator: Bruce Pinsky

items.title: Introducing tunnel endpoints for private access to network segments
items.summary: Tunnel endpoints are a new VPC endpoint type, powered by AWS PrivateLink, that gives an application in one VPC private access to an entire range of IP addresses in another VPC. The network owner shares a CIDR block once, and every resource inside it becomes reachable, including resources created later.
items.creator: Bruce Pinsky
